nodes.name: power_boost_9v
nodes.description: MT3608 boost converter generates VCC_9V from USB_5V for NE5532 preamplifier. EN pin tied to VIN for always-on operation. FB pin connects to feedback divider network to set 9V output. SW pin is the switching node. Output needs bulk and bypass capacitors. This module is the sole VCC_9V provider.

nodes.name: SW
nodes.description: Power switch output, drain of internal MOSFET, connects to inductor and output rectifier, swings between GND and 28V

nodes.name: EN

nodes.name: VIN

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps USB_5V down to VCC_3V3 for ATmega328P and MCP4725. Input and output need bypass capacitors. This module is the VCC_3V3 distribution hub for digital and mixed-signal modules.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P AVR MCU running on internal clock or external crystal (not specified, assume internal 8MHz or external provision). PC4/PC5 configured as I2C master (SCL/SDA) to control MCP4725 DAC. I2C pull-up resistors placed in this module. AVCC and VCC tied to VCC_3V3. AREF available for external reference if needed. Digital ground returns to star point.

nodes.name: dac_control
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC provides GAIN_CTRL analog output to NE5532 preamplifier. A0 pin tied to GND or VCC to set I2C address (brief implies single device, address selection not critical). VOUT drives shared control/bias network for both NE5532 channels. No active gain control circuit per brief—DAC output provides static or slowly varying bias/gain control voltage.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamp
nodes.description: NE5532 dual low-noise op-amp stereo preamplifier powered from VCC_9V (positive rail) and GND (negative rail, single-supply operation). IN1_P/IN2_P receive left/right audio inputs (external source, not in component list). IN1_N/IN2_N form inverting inputs with feedback networks. GAIN_CTRL from DAC provides bias/gain control to both channels. OUT1/OUT2 drive PAM8403 left/right inputs. VCC_P is +9V rail, VCC_N is ground reference. Star-ground connection to system GND.

nodes.name: power_amp
nodes.description: PAM8403 3W stereo Class-D amplifier. Powered directly from USB_5V (VDD, PVDD_1, PVDD_2) with common GND. INL/INR receive left/right preamplified signals from NE5532. OUT_L_P/N and OUT_R_P/N drive external stereo speakers (not in component list). MUTE and SHDN tied to enable normal operation (active-low, tie to VDD for enable). VREF provides internal reference. PGND_1/2 are power ground returns. Analog/digital star-ground intent: PGND connects to system GND at appropriate point.
